args.title: Handle invalid date range errors gracefully in report creation
args.body:
File: src/db/repos/reportRepo.ts

Validate input dates (such as `from` and `to`) before inserting them into the database to prevent Postgres date/time range errors from bubbling up as unhandled 500 internal errors. Catch or validate date string formats properly so invalid dates return a 400 client error instead.
